metadataRaw.title: Release THIS Muscle for Instant Hip Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe reveals the key muscle group responsible for hip pain—and how to quickly release its tightness for lasting relief.

Hip pain often stems from built-up tension and tightness in certain muscles, leading to strain and inflammation. But which muscle is the main culprit? In this video, you'll discover how tight and weak glutes could be the hidden cause of your discomfort—and the best exercises to fix it.

Each exercise targets the glutes differently, so try them all and see which gives you the most relief.

Best of all, these exercises can be done at home with no equipment needed.

Watch now to unlock the secret to hip pain relief!
